documents.title: Example

genome.hypothesis:
The tool is shown the repository, records what it found, and then a file is moved byte for byte. The defect in it did not change: same lines, same order, same everything except where it lives.

A tool whose finding identity is derived from the path now has one finding that vanished and one that is brand new, and nothing joining them. Two costs, both invisible in a diff: a committed baseline stops matching, so a triaged repository reads as untriaged; and the history shows a defect resolved that nobody resolved.

Renaming a module is the most ordinary thing a repository does.
